fullDescription: Clean YC-classic light startup landing page: white paper base with a faint slate grid, single warm orange accent, Inter extrabold tight-tracked headlines with an orange highlight swipe, a centered hero, an in-product app screenshot, backed-by logo row, feature trio, 3-step how-it-works, and a dark orange-glow CTA panel.
prompt:
## Resumo
A confident YC-classic light startup landing page. Clean white paper background with a faint slate grid, a warm orange accent system (orange #ff6b35 actions, soft orange wash highlights), near-black slate ink type set in Inter (extrabold display, tight -0.045em tracking), and a single hero highlight phrase marked by a translucent orange underline swipe. Centered hero with a pill announcement chip, a big two-line headline, a sub-paragraph, two CTAs, an avatar + 5-star social-proof row, then a large in-product app screenshot (toolbar + prompt rail + generated preview card) sitting on a soft browser shadow. Below: a backed-by/trusted-by logo row, a 3-up feature trio, a 3-step how-it-works with a connector line, a dark ink CTA panel with orange glow blobs, and a 5-column footer.

## Estilo Visual
Design in a clean YC-classic light SaaS style. Palette: paper white #ffffff, wash #f7f8fb for alternating sections, hairline borders #e7eaf0; text in slate ink #0f172a (headings), slate-2 #334155 (body), muted #64748b (secondary). Single warm accent orange #ff6b35 with hover #e8551f, on an orange wash #fff4ee for soft chips/highlights. Use the Inter font for all text: extrabold (800) / black (900) display headings with very tight letter-spacing (-0.045em, call it 'tightest') and ~0.98 line-height; medium and semibold for nav/UI. Shadows are soft and layered: a 'browser-shadow' under the product screenshot (0 24px 48px -12px rgba(15,23,42,0.14) plus a faint orange 0 8px 16px -8px rgba(255,107,53,0.10)); a lighter 'card-shadow' on cards and pills; an orange-tinted 'btn-orange-shadow' under primary buttons. Behind the hero put a faint 56px x 56px slate grid (rgba(15,23,42,0.04) 1px lines) and a top-down light orange-wash gradient (~420px tall). For one highlighted hero phrase, add a translucent orange swipe behind the text via ::after: left/right -2px, bottom 0.06em, height 0.42em, background #ff6b35 at 20% opacity, rounded 2px, z-index -1. Buttons are rounded ~10-12px; pills/badges are fully rounded; eyebrow labels are uppercase with 0.16em letter-spacing. Keep it crisp, confident and investor-ready, never neon, dark-by-default, or visually heavy.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky nav
A sticky top header (z-50) with a translucent paper background (bg-paper/85) and backdrop blur, a hairline bottom border, and a 68px-tall row inside a max-w-[1180px] container. Left: a logo lockup, a rounded-[9px] orange square badge (with orange button-shadow) holding a white lucide:rocket icon, plus the 'Liftoff' wordmark in extrabold Inter with tight -0.045em tracking. Center: horizontal nav links (Templates, Features, How it works, Pricing) at 14.5px medium in slate-2, hovering to ink, hidden below lg. Right: a ghost 'Log in' text link (hidden on the smallest screens) and a solid orange rounded-[10px] 'Start free' pill CTA with a lucide:arrow-right icon and the orange button-shadow.

### Hero
A centered hero on white with a faint 56px slate grid behind it and a top-down light orange-wash gradient (~420px tall), inside a max-w-[1180px] container, generous pt-20/pb-16 (lg pt-28/pb-20). Center column: a rounded-full announcement pill (paper, hairline border, card-shadow) with a tiny orange circle + white lucide:sparkles, the text '1,400+ founder-grade page templates' and a muted chevron-right. Then a huge headline, max-w-[860px], 44 to 58 to 72px, Inter extrabold, tracking -0.045em, leading 0.98, reading 'Ship a startup site investors take seriously.' where 'take seriously' is orange and carries the translucent orange underline swipe. A sub-paragraph (max-w-[600px], 17 to 18.5px, slate-2) describing prompt-to-page on an infinite canvas. Two CTAs: a solid orange rounded-[12px] 'Start designing free' with arrow (orange button-shadow) and a ghost paper rounded-[12px] 'Watch a 90s build' with an orange lucide:play and card-shadow. Below, a social-proof row: an overlapping avatar stack of four 32px initial circles (orange / ink / slate-2 / orangeDark, each with a 2px paper ring) next to five orange star icons and 'Loved by 12,000+ founders'. A muted fine-print line 'No credit card. Free templates. Ship on your own domain.'

### Product screenshot (in-app mock)
A wide product screenshot card, max-w-[980px], centered below the hero: rounded-[16px] paper card with a hairline border and the soft orange-tinted browser-shadow, NOT a browser chrome but an in-product UI. Top: an app toolbar (44px, wash background, hairline bottom border) with a small orange rocket badge, the project label 'acme-ai · landing', and an orange 'Auto-saved' chip on the left; on the right, muted undo/redo icons, a divider, and a small orange 'Publish' chip. Body is a two-pane canvas: a left prompt rail (230px, hidden below md, hairline right border) with an uppercase 'PROMPT' eyebrow, a wash-filled bordered card quoting an example prompt, an orange 'Generating sections' line with a wand icon, and a small checklist (Hero + CTA ✓, Logo wall ✓, Feature trio loading) using orange lucide check/loader icons; the right pane is a wash + grid 'generated preview' holding a small rounded paper card: an uppercase orange 'AI MEETING NOTES' eyebrow, an extrabold 'Never write meeting notes again.' headline, a muted one-line sub, two mini buttons (solid orange 'Get started', ghost 'Book a demo'), and a faded logo row (Notion, Slack, Zoom, Linear simple-icons).

### Backed-by / logo row
A trust band on paper with hairline top+bottom borders, inside max-w-[1180px], py-10/12. A centered uppercase muted eyebrow 'Backed by, and trusted by teams from', then a centered flex-wrap row of six investor/brand lockups (Y Combinator with the simple-icons:ycombinator mark, Sequoia, a16z, Initialized, Founders Fund, Pioneer) each as a small monochrome icon + ink bold name at ~16px, rendered at 70% opacity and brightening to 100% on hover.

### Feature trio
A features section (id=features) on the wash background with a hairline bottom border, inside max-w-[1180px], py-20/24. A left-aligned header block (max-w-[640px]): an uppercase orange eyebrow 'Why founders pick Liftoff', an extrabold 32 to 42px heading 'A design team in a text box.' (tracking -0.045em), and a slate-2 sub-paragraph. Below, a 3-up grid (1 col on mobile) of rounded-[14px] paper cards with hairline borders and card-shadow that lift on hover (-translate-y-1). Each card: a 44px rounded-[11px] orange-wash icon tile (hairline orange/15 border) with an orange lucide icon (message-square-text / layout-template / code-2), a bold ~19px title (Prompt to full page / Infinite canvas / Ship the real code), and a slate-2 description line.

### How it works (3 steps)
A how-it-works section (id=how) on paper with a hairline bottom border, py-20/24. A centered header (max-w-[560px]): uppercase orange eyebrow 'How it works' and an extrabold 32 to 42px heading 'Idea to live in three steps.' Below, a 3-up grid (stacks on mobile) with a dashed-fade horizontal connector line on desktop (a thin line behind the circles, faded at both ends via a linear-gradient through #e7eaf0). Each step is centered: a 52px orange circle (white extrabold numeral 1/2/3, orange button-shadow), a bold ~18px title (Describe it / Shape it / Ship it), and a slate-2 description (max-w-[280px]).

### Dark CTA panel
A final CTA section (id=cta) on the wash background, py-20/24, holding one rounded-[22px] dark ink (#0f172a) panel with generous padding (px-8/16, py-14/16). Inside, two large blurred orange glow blobs in opposite corners (orange/25 top-right, orange/15 bottom-left, blur-3xl). Centered content: an extrabold white headline (32 to 46px, tracking -0.045em) 'Your startup deserves a first impression that converts.' where 'first impression' is orange; a slate-300 sub-paragraph (max-w-[480px]); and two CTAs, a solid orange rounded-[12px] 'Start designing free' with arrow (button-shadow) and a translucent white-outline ghost 'Talk to us'.

### Footer
A footer on paper with a hairline top border, inside max-w-[1180px], py-14. A grid (2 cols mobile / 4 sm / 5 lg). The first 2-col block: the rocket-badge 'Liftoff' wordmark, a short muted description, and three 36px rounded social icon buttons (X / GitHub / YouTube simple-icons) with hairline borders that turn orange on hover. Three link columns (Product, Company, Resources) each with a bold ~13px ink heading and a stack of muted 14px links hovering to ink. A top-bordered bottom bar (mt-12, pt-7) splits the copyright '© 2026 Liftoff Labs, Inc. All rights reserved.' from a small Privacy / Terms / Status link row.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
Translucent orange highlight swipe: a ::after bar behind one hero phrase (height 0.42em, background #ff6b35 at 20% opacity, rounded 2px, z-index -1) reading like a hand-marked highlight

### Componente
Faint 56px x 56px slate grid background (rgba(15,23,42,0.04) 1px lines) behind the hero and inside the product mock's preview pane

### Componente
Soft browser-shadow under the product screenshot, layering a slate drop shadow with a faint orange 0 8px 16px -8px rgba(255,107,53,0.10) tint

### Componente
Orange-tinted button shadow (btn-orange-shadow) under all primary orange CTAs and the rocket/step badges

### Componente
In-product app mock with a toolbar (Auto-saved + Publish chips), a left prompt rail with a generating checklist, and a generated-preview card, NOT a browser chrome

### Componente
Overlapping avatar proof stack: four 32px initial circles (orange / ink / slate-2 / orangeDark) each with a 2px paper ring, beside five orange star icons

### Componente
Dashed-fade horizontal connector line behind the 3 how-it-works step circles, faded at both ends via a linear-gradient through #e7eaf0

### Componente
Dark ink CTA panel with two large blurred orange glow blobs (blur-3xl) in opposite corners

### Componente
Iconify icons: lucide (rocket, arrow-right, sparkles, chevron-right, play, message-square-text, layout-template, code-2, wand-2, check, loader, undo-2, redo-2, triangle, hexagon, gem, circle-dot, square-stack), material-symbols star-rounded, and simple-icons (ycombinator, notion, slack, zoom, linear, x, github, youtube)

### Componente
Uppercase wide-tracked eyebrow labels (0.16em) above each section heading

## Notas Especiais
Single font: Inter (Google Fonts, weights 400-900), used for everything with -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased and text-rendering:optimizeLegibility. Styled with Tailwind via CDN using a custom theme palette (ink #0f172a, slate2 #334155, muted #64748b, line #e7eaf0, paper #ffffff, wash #f7f8fb, orange #ff6b35, orangeDark #e8551f, orangeWash #fff4ee) and a custom 'tightest' letter-spacing of -0.045em. html has scroll-behavior:smooth. Keep exactly one warm accent (orange) over a white/near-white base with hairline slate borders; do not introduce a second accent hue, dark-mode-by-default, or neon. The mood is clean, confident and investor-ready, classic YC SaaS, not playful or maximalist.
